verdict.rationale: RunAnywhere ships an official CLI (Wally) that runs local models offline without an account, and an OpenAI-compatible endpoint callable from standard clients, so scripted automation is plausible. However, nothing documents headless or CI use, and Cloud authentication is a browser-approval flow that suits interactive terminals rather than unattended pipelines. Missing for 10: documented headless/CI mode, non-interactive (token/env-var) auth for Cloud, CI examples or exit-code/output-format docs, independent hands-on corroboration of unattended runs.
